description: This file defines multiple repository interface protocols for a backend service, including user, conversation, feedback, and document repositories. It also includes a data class for insert operation results.

classes.name: InsertResult
classes.description: A data class representing the result of an insert operation, containing the inserted document ID.

classes.name: UsersRepo
classes.description: A protocol defining user-related repository operations, specifically creation of stub users.

classes.name: ConversationsRepo
classes.description: A protocol defining conversation repository operations, specifically adding conversations.

classes.name: FeedbackRepo
classes.description: A protocol defining feedback or audit log repository operations.

classes.name: DocumentsRepo
classes.description: A protocol for document metadata management operations.

classes.name: RepoBundle
classes.description: A protocol that groups together various repositories (users, conversations, feedback, documents) provided by the backend.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_stub_if_missing(self, username: str, language: str = "en")
methods.description: Creates a stub user if not exists, returning a user document as a dictionary.

methods.name: InsertResult add_conversation(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a conversation document and returns an InsertResult.

methods.name: InsertResult add_audit_log(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts an audit log entry and returns an InsertResult.

methods.name: InsertResult add_document_meta(self, doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts document metadata and returns an InsertResult.

ctags.name: add_audit_log
ctags.pattern: /^    async def add_audit_log(self, doc: Dict[str, Any]) -> InsertResult:$/

ctags.name: add_conversation
ctags.pattern: /^    async def add_conversation(self, doc: Dict[str, Any]) -> InsertResult:$/

ctags.name: add_document_meta
ctags.pattern: /^    async def add_document_meta(self, doc: Dict[str, Any]) -> InsertResult:$/

ctags.name: create_stub_if_missing
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create_stub_if_missing(self, username: str, language: str = "en") -> Dict[str, Any/
